facts.fact: FinTech Gate reports that Egypt's guideline for government procurement of AI systems, prepared under the communications and IT ministry (MCIT) and adopted by the National Council for AI, Quantum Computing and Emerging Technologies, sets bidder qualification (a technical score of at least 75 of 100), human review and complaint routes, and binds a contractor only where a tender document includes it.
facts.system: Egyptian guideline for procurement of AI systems

systems.owner: MCIT with the Egyptian Center for Responsible AI; adopted by the National Council for AI
